This Cancellation and Refund Policy applies to Listo Qasa marketplace listing packages and real-estate professional listing plans. It does not apply to Cortexa CRM subscriptions or other Cortexa services.

## 1. PROPERTY-OWNER LISTING PACKAGES

Owner listing packages are prepaid for the one-month or three-month period selected at checkout. They are one-time purchases and do not automatically renew.

When the selected period ends, the package expires. Listo Qasa will not charge you for another period unless you choose to renew by purchasing a new package.

The package’s paid exposure benefits and listing allowance apply only during the period purchased. After expiration, listings may lose paid placement or be paused under the plan rules shown on the Platform. To continue using a paid owner package, purchase another package.

Not using a listing package, removing a listing, or receiving fewer inquiries than expected does not extend the package period. Refund and cancellation rights that apply under law remain available.

## 2. AGENT, AGENCY, AND DEVELOPER PLANS

Professional listing plans are recurring monthly subscriptions. They renew monthly until canceled.

To cancel, send a written request through the support channel listed in the Listo Qasa Terms of Service. Include the account email and the plan you want to cancel. We will confirm receipt and process the request in accordance with applicable law.

There is no cancellation fee. You remain responsible for amounts lawfully due for service provided through the effective cancellation date. Cancellation stops future renewals once it takes effect. To help prevent another renewal charge, submit your request before the next billing date.

When the paid subscription ends, its paid features and listing allowance end. Listings may be paused or lose paid placement under the plan rules shown on the Platform. You may renew by keeping the plan active or purchasing an available plan again.

## 3. REFUND REQUESTS

Refund requests are reviewed under the checkout terms and applicable law. Nothing in this Policy waives or limits a consumer cancellation, return, refund, or other right that cannot legally be waived.

If you believe you were charged incorrectly, charged more than once, or did not receive the package or subscription you purchased, submit a written request through the support channel listed in the Terms of Service. Include your account email, the payment date, the amount, and the transaction reference if available.

If a refund is approved, it will generally be returned through the original payment method where possible. The time it takes for the funds to appear may depend on the payment provider or bank.

## 4. STATUTORY CONSUMER RIGHTS

Where applicable, Ecuadorian consumer law may provide rights to terminate a service or request a return or refund. Any such request will be handled according to the law that applies to the transaction. If this Policy conflicts with a mandatory legal right, the mandatory legal right controls.

## 5. EFFECT OF CANCELLATION

Canceling a professional plan prevents future renewals once the cancellation takes effect; it does not automatically cancel a separate product or add-on.

An owner listing package ends when its prepaid period expires. It does not require a cancellation request and does not renew automatically.

Canceling or allowing a listing package to expire does not cancel an agreement, booking, sale, rental, or payment arrangement made directly between a property provider and another user. Those arrangements are handled by the parties to them.
